notes: Official page (tcd.ie) confirms this is a merit-based tuition-fee reduction (EUR2,000-5,000) for full-time postgraduate TAUGHT programmes, assessed on academic achievement and potential contribution to the Trinity community on a rolling basis. No supervisor or named faculty member is attached to the award. Contact routes are administrative only: Trinity Regional Managers/Advisors (tcd.ie/global/people and tcd.ie/study/country) and the Academic Registry (academic.registry@tcd.ie). No professor evidence found, so professors array is empty.

Manaaki New Zealand Scholarships are a New Zealand Government scheme administered by Education New Zealand | Manapou ki te Ao (nzscholarships.govt.nz), with applications via the official MNZSP applicant portal. There is no attached institution: eligible citizens of developing countries study at one of several New Zealand or Pacific universities/institutes of their choosing, and the programme also runs vocational, thematic cohort and English-language strands. No supervising professor or faculty can be tied to this national scheme.

Official page (auckland.ac.nz) confirms this is a tuition fee credit (up to 25% of one year of tuition) for new international Master's students, with no separate application: 'It is awarded on the recommendation of the relevant faculty or University of Auckland committee.' No named supervisor or professor is tied to the award. Support contact is the administrative Student Support Team/AskAuckland, not an academic supervisor.

The University of Auckland Doctoral Scholarship is a university-wide scheme (stipend NZD35,468 pa in 2026 plus tuition, up to 42 months FTE) covering all faculties, Large Scale Research Institutes and University Research Centres, awarded in four rounds per year. No separate scholarship application exists: any student offered a place in a doctoral programme is considered, and the supervision team is established at doctoral programme application stage via each faculty's Supervisor Statement (e.g., Faculty of Science and Faculty of Education doctoral scholarship pages direct applicants to the generic staff profiles directory at profiles.auckland.ac.nz to find accredited supervisors). No specific professor is tied to the scholarship itself, so no verified supervisors are recorded. Official University of Otago pages (otago.ac.nz/international/future-students/fees-scholarships/international-scholarships and the Global Scholarships detail page and regulations PDF) confirm this is an undergraduate entrance tuition scholarship (NZD15,000, one year) for new international Bachelor students from nominated countries, automatically assessed during the admission process with no extra application. No supervisor or named faculty member is attached; the published contact is the administrative Undergraduate Entrance Scholarships office (entrance.scholarships@otago.ac.nz), not a professor.

Official University of Otago detail page and regulations PDF (VCSIS-Regulations.pdf) confirm this is an undergraduate entrance tuition scholarship (NZD10,000, one year) for new international Bachelor students, automatically assessed during the admission process via eVision. Selection is based on academic potential as demonstrated by programme admission. No supervisor or named faculty member is attached to the award.

Official University of Otago detail page and regulations PDF (International-Academic-Excellence-Regulations.pdf) confirm this is an invitation-based undergraduate competitive scholarship (approx. NZD35,000: first-year residential college accommodation plus tuition in years 2-3) assessed in eVision after a prior scholarship offer is accepted. Continuation requests go to the administrative Manager, Undergraduate Entrance Scholarships (entrance.scholarships@otago.ac.nz). No supervising professor or named faculty member is tied to the award.
